EmailTemplate.description: QCC: Arrival Airport compliment request email template will be sent 2pm the following day when the request was raised. CRM-8664
EmailTemplate.name: QCC_Arrival_Airport_Letter_1C
EmailTemplate.subject: Qantas Customer Care - {!Case.CaseNumber}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Ref No: {!Case.CaseNumber}
Dear {!Case.Contact}
Thank you very much for contacting us with your lovely comments about your recent airport experience. We are always keen to hear back from our customers and are so happy when it is great feedback like this.
We want you to arrive safe and comfortable at your destination so we are very glad to read everything went well on your arrival. I’ve sent a copy of your message through to our Airport Management to pass on to the team there, and I know that they will be really pleased to read what you have to say.
We are grateful you took the time to write and look forward to welcoming you aboard again soon.
Kind regards
Qantas Customer Care
Note: This email was sent from a notification only address that cannot accept incoming email. Please do not reply to this message.
